blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein is heading ka number “7.1.2.3” chhapa hai. Yeh 7.3.2 (Impacts of the Digital Divide) ka teesra hissa hai, is liye sahi number 7.3.2.3 hai.

Digital divide samaji aur civic participation (shehri zindagi aur hukumati kaamon mein hissa lena) par bhi asar dalta hai. Social media, online news aur digital government services ki madad se log bakhabar (informed) rehte hain aur civic activities (shehri sargarmiyon) mein hissa lete hain. Lekin jin ke paas rasai nahi, woh aksar in mauqon se bahar reh jate hain, aur jamhoori (democratic) amal mein un ki numaindagi (representation) aur shirakat kam ho jati hai.

Misal: Pakistan mein e-government services (online sarkari services) shehron mein zyada aasani se milti hain, is liye dehi aabadi ke paas hukumati kaamon mein hissa lene ya samaji services tak pohanchne ke kam zariye hain.

blocks.prompt: Samaji aur civic participation par digital divide ke do asar bataiye. (Short question 4)
blocks.explanation: 1) Jin ke paas rasai nahi woh social media aur online news se kam bakhabar rehte hain, is liye jamhoori amal mein un ki numaindagi aur shirakat kam hoti hai. 2) E-government services zyada tar shehron mein aasani se milti hain, is liye dehi log hukumati kaamon mein hissa lene aur samaji services tak pohanchne mein peeche reh jate hain.

items: Shehri asar: kam maloomat, kam numaindagi, dehi ilaqon mein e-government services tak kam rasai.
